d:
A lively musical treat from the golden era of Bollywood! Kisi Se Dosti Karlo from the 1974 film Dil Diwana features Randhir Kapoor and Poonam Sinha. Sung by the legendary duo Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle, this delightful song brings together their unmistakable voices and the vibrant charm of 70s Hindi film music.
Kisi Se Dosti Karlo | Dil Diwana (1974) | Randhir Kapoor, Poonam Sinha | Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
Song: Kisi Se Dosti Karlo
Movie: Dil Diwana (1974)
Star Cast: Randhir Kapoor, Poonam Sinha
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
Music Director: RD Burman
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
